You will serve as a Sea-Launched Cruise Missile (Nuclear) (SLCM-N) Program Analyst at Strategic Systems Program (SSP) in Washington, DC.
You will provide special technical analysis and guidance on procurement, budget execution, and the strategy and planning for SSP.
You will support the SP leadership to integrate SLCM-N acquisition with the development and maintenance of technical documentation, technical design, prototype, and development of the required documents in support of acquisition reviews.
You will support the development of the overall SSP test strategy, technical data package reviews, weapon system analysis, subsystem objective and quality evidence.
You will support the development of integrated master schedules, action plans, and inchstones used to ensure technical rigor is maintained for strategic weapon systems.
Your resume must also demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the NH-03 (GS-13) grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Provide technical analysis and guidance for major defense systems acquisition to support acquisition planning, budget execution, and lifecycle management in meeting program objectives.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management website:Program Management Series 0340 Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Control and manage project milestones and budgets from planning through construction and initial operations.
Allocate project funds to District elements, consistent with progress attained, and measure and monitor performance to assure that commitments of all parties are being maintained.
Review and analyze cost reports to assure charges are all authorized and appropriate; identify unauthorized charges and assure corrective actions are taken for the ultimate disposition of inappropriate charges.
Monitor progress, measure performance and take necessary corrective action to maintain agreed-upon schedule and cost.
Coordinate planning, design, cost-engineering, construction and environmental restoration, etc., for engineering or planning projects of substantial scope and complexity.
Assure the overall management, control, coordination and execution of assigned projects.
As the project team leader, implement corporate decisions, guidance, laws, regulations and policies in the development of the project and intermediate products in support of the project.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application. Additional information about transcripts is in this document.

Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience which includes: 1) Managing milestones, contract administration and budgets of multiple projects through development and delivery; 2) Implementing scope, schedule and budget development, along with design, engineering or construction management in regards to construction/renovation of buildings, facilities, fueling systems and other infrastructure projects or environmental restoration type work; AND 3) Integrating customer requirements into a coordinated management plan.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service (GS-11). Some federal jobs allow you to substitute your education for the required experience in order to qualify.

For this job, you must meet the qualification requirement using experience alone--no substitution of education for experience is permitted. Time in Grade Requirement: Applicants who have held a General Schedule (GS) position within the last 52 weeks must have 52 weeks of Federal service at the next lower grade or equivalent (GS-11).

VA Careers - Pharmacy: https://youtube.com/embed/Fn_ickNBEws The Pharmacy Program Manager (Pharmacoeconomics/Formulary Management) is responsible for leading and coordinating pharmacoeconomic programs, formulary management activities, and cost-containment initiatives across VA North Texas.

Their scope spans Program Management, Administrative & Quality Assurance, Research & Education, Clinical Practice, and Communication. A. Program Management Leads cost-containment strategies, formulary maintenance, drug utilization reviews, and pharmacoeconomic research. Evaluates new medications for budget impact and formulary considerations.

Oversees cost-efficient use of high-cost or high-risk medications and may serve as approval authority. Conducts drug use evaluations, tracks KPIs, analyzes trends, and implements improvement plans. Manages Prior Authorization Drug Requests, therapeutic interchange activities, formulary reviews, and formulary change processes.

Develops medication criteria for use and tools to measure outcomes of formulary and pharmacoeconomic interventions. Collaborates on drug shortages, recalls, adverse drug event monitoring, and REMS activities. B. Administrative and Quality Assurance Performs data analytics using tools such as SQL, Power BI, Pyramid, and Excel.

Maintains pharmacoeconomic resources and references. Participates in quality improvement initiatives, policy development, and P&T Committee activities (facility and VISN). Ensures drug file accuracy and provides consultation on drug procurement, cost analysis, and patient care.

Documents cost-avoidance activities and supports performance measure achievement. C. Research and Education Supports trainee education and provides preceptorship in pharmacoeconomics and research. Coordinates clinical research, outcomes studies, and real-world evidence assessments.

Educates staff and providers on formulary management, guidelines, and cost-effective drug use. Contributes to VISN and national PBM research and drug utilization evaluation initiatives. Completes required training and supports staff development. D.

Clinical Reviews medication regimens for safety, effectiveness, dosing, interactions, and therapeutic outcomes. Monitors and reports drug errors, adverse reactions, allergies, and compliance. Applies laboratory interpretation skills for dose adjustments and patient assessment.

Monitors high-risk and high-cost medication use and formulary adherence using dashboards. Identifies misuse, inappropriate dosing, duplications, interactions, suboptimal response, and deprescribing opportunities. Provides cost-effective therapeutic recommendations and pharmacokinetic guidance.

Serves as a drug information resource and documents clinical interventions. E. Communication Maintains effective relationships with providers, nursing staff, and other departments. Serves as an authoritative resource to resolve medication-related questions and ensures positive communication experiences.

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, between 7am- 5pm /8 hour work schedule); Tour may be adjusted or extended to meet patient care needs. Telework: Not Available Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Die Modern Drive Technology GmbH (MDT) ist ein Full-Service-IoT-Cloud-Integrator mit Fokus auf OEMs und Maschinenproduzenten . Mit unserer offenen Plattform ermöglichen wir Herstellern, ihren Maschinen und Produkten eine eigene, vollständig gebrandete digitale Servicewelt zu geben – ohne selbst eine Cloud-Infrastruktur aufbauen zu müssen.
Ob Fernwartung, Predictive Maintenance oder datenbasierte After-Sales-Services: Wir liefern die technologische Grundlage, damit OEMs ihren Kunden smarte Mehrwerte anbieten und neue Geschäftsmodelle erschließen können.
Bereits über 100 Kunden mit mehr als 13.000 vernetzten Einheiten setzen auf unsere Lösung – und wir wachsen weiter.
Aufgaben
Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unserem Entwicklungsteam. Du verstehst, was Kunden wirklich brauchen, formulierst es technisch präzise und stellst sicher, dass Projekte strukturiert, termingerecht und im Sinne des Kunden umgesetzt werden.
Dabei bringst du eigene Einschätzungen zu Anforderungen und Prioritäten ein – die finale Roadmap-Entscheidung triffst du gemeinsam mit der Entwicklungsleitung und der Geschäftsführung. Du hältst beide Welten zusammen: die des Kunden und die des Teams.
Deine Aufgaben
Anforderungsaufnahme & Spezifikation – du führst Gespräche mit Kunden, erkennst den eigentlichen Bedarf und übersetzt ihn in klare User Stories und Tickets für das Dev-Team
Kunden-Onboarding & Betreuung – du begleitest neue Kunden von der ersten Integration bis zum produktiven Betrieb und bist langfristiger Ansprechpartner
Produktdemos & Kundenpräsentationen – du präsentierst unsere Plattform überzeugend, technisch fundiert und auf den jeweiligen Kunden zugeschnitten
Koordination & Kommunikation – du hältst Kunden über Projektstatus auf dem Laufenden und sorgst dafür, dass das Dev-Team stets die richtigen Prioritäten kennt
Roadmap-Input – du bündelst Kundenfeedback und Marktanforderungen und bringst sie strukturiert in die Abstimmung mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung ein
Qualifikation

Technisches Grundverständnis – du weißt, wie APIs, Cloud-Architekturen und Softwareentwicklung funktionieren, auch wenn du selbst nicht codest
Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Entwicklungsteams, z.B. in agilen Projekten (Scrum, Kanban)
Ausgeprägtes Kommunikationsgeschick – du kannst technische Sachverhalte für Kunden verständlich machen und Kundenwünsche präzise ins Team übersetzen
Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, den Überblick zu behalten
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Erfahrung im IoT-, SaaS- oder Industrieumfeld
Kenntnisse in gängigen Projektmanagement-Tools (z.B. Jira, Linear, Notion)
Erfahrung mit API-Dokumentation oder technischen Spezifikationen
Erfahrung im Kundenprojektgeschäft mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten
Präsenz: Ein Tag pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Büro in Neumarkt i.d.Opf. erwünscht
Offen für alle Erfahrungsstufen – ob Berufseinsteiger mit technischem Hintergrund oder erfahrene Projektmanagerin: Wir freuen uns auf dich.

As a Commercial Project Manager for the Aerospace, Defense, & Marine BU, you will help lead commercially driven initiatives that bring structure, alignment, and momentum to complex customer-focused work.

Based in a remote role, you will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to organize projects, clarify priorities, and support execution across programs tied to customer engagement, customer centricity, and customer performance .

This is a newly created opportunity for an experienced project professional who can bring discipline to ambiguity, connect business needs to actionable plans, and keep broad teams moving in the same direction.
You will join an environment where projects are centered solving business and customer challenges that may involve multiple teams, sites, and functions. In this role, you will help shape how commercial initiatives are structured and managed, supporting efforts such as ongoing customer-focused programs and the commercial TEOA journey .

This is a strong fit for someone with proven project management capability, strong business and customer acumen , and the ability to translate complex needs into practical next steps across a distributed organization.

Lead commercially driven projects that require strong coordination across functions, with a focus on customer-related priorities and business outcomes.
Bring structure to complex initiatives by helping define project scope, organize activities, and guide stakeholders through execution in a clear and disciplined way.
Translate customer needs and business requirements into actionable plans, helping teams understand what must happen to move from problem identification to resolution.
Track program and stakeholder progress, helping ensure actions are assigned, followed through, and aligned to agreed timelines and expectations.
Support problem-solving efforts for complex customer situations that cannot be resolved by a single person, team, or site, bringing the right stakeholders together to move work forward.
Apply project management tools and practices such as planning, coordination, accountability, and timeline management to commercial initiatives in a practical and effective way.
Contribute to ongoing initiatives related to operational excellence on the commercial side , helping teams build ownership and accountability as projects advance.
Work across internal teams to maintain alignment, identify blockers, and help keep projects progressing through the appropriate steps and decision points.

Experience in project management within a business, commercial, or cross-functional environment where influence and coordination are critical to success.
Strong business acumen and customer acumen , with the ability to understand customer needs and connect them to practical internal actions.
Demonstrated strength in structure, process, problem solving, and big-picture thinking .
Ability to work effectively in roles that involve significant cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and shared accountability.
Confidence operating in situations with ambiguity, where projects are still being defined and require someone who can create clarity and forward motion.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bring people together, align different perspectives, and maintain focus on priorities.
A balanced approach that combines process discipline with flexibility, especially in ongoing programs that evolve over time.
Comfort working with teams that include subject matter experts, using their input to build coordinated plans without needing to be the technical expert in every area.
What you'll need
Proven ability to manage projects using core project management practices such as planning, scope management, timeline coordination, and stakeholder follow-through .
Experience supporting programs that involve multiple stakeholders and require consistent accountability across functions.
Readiness to work in a remote position while staying closely connected with internal teams and business partners.
Familiarity with customer-focused business environments where progress depends on coordination across teams rather than direct authority.
Ability to assess incoming priorities, organize next steps, and help determine which actions and stakeholders are needed to achieve project goals.
Willingness to step into a newly created role and help establish a strong foundation for how commercial projects are managed going forward.

At TE Connectivity , you will have the opportunity to help define a new role with meaningful visibility and impact. This position offers the chance to support important commercial priorities in a way that directly influences how teams respond to customer needs, organize complex work, and improve execution across the business.
You will be part of a collaborative environment where strong project leadership is valued, especially in situations that require alignment across functions and thoughtful problem solving.

The role also offers the flexibility of a remote working model , along with exposure to strategic commercial initiatives and ongoing operational excellence efforts.

For someone who enjoys turning complexity into coordinated action and partnering with others to drive progress, this is a strong opportunity to contribute in a highly connected role at TE Connectivity .
Please note : This position may involve working with technical data, technology, software/source code, hardware or other items (collectively “items) subject to U.S. and non-U.S. export control laws and regulations.

Under these regulations, it may be necessary for TE to verify a candidate’s national origin and/or citizenship status to determine whether a U.S. or other government export license is required prior to releasing its technologies to the candidate.

Unser dynamisches Team aus derzeit 17 Mitarbeitenden vereint umfassende Erfahrung aus der Strategieberatung (MBB) sowie der Entwicklung, dem Bau und dem Betrieb von Batteriespeicher- und Erneuerbare-Energien-Projekten. Klub44 ist ein gemeinnütziges Startup im Bereich digitale Jugendbeteiligung. Mit der Klub-App ermöglichen wir es jungen Menschen, ihre eigene Stadt und ihre Vorlieben zu entdecken, und die Welt um sich herum mitzugestalten. Alle jungen Menschen haben das Recht auf ein freies und schöpferisches Leben, daran glauben wir fest.
Nebenbei möchten wir die Schul- und Berufsbildung radikal transformieren.
Mit der Klub-App erhalten Jugendliche ab 12 Jahren einen chancengerechten Zugang zu kostenfreien Freizeit- und Berufsorientierungsangeboten. Außerschulische Standorte – z. B. Jugendclubs, Makerspaces, Orte der kulturellen Bildung – können auf unserer App ihre Angebote direkt und digital an Jugendliche kommunizieren. Das Ganze bauen wir als Game auf: Entdecke deine Stadt, dich selbst, und bekomme dafür Rewards!
Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich Menschen aller Geschlechter, Religionen und sexuellen Orientierungen dazu, sich bei uns zu bewerben!
Aufgaben
Als Projektmanager*in Kooperationen bist du die Person, bei der unsere operativen Projekte zusammenlaufen. Kommunen, Schulen und Stiftungen arbeiten mit uns, weil sie ein Ergebnis wollen – du sorgst dafür, dass dieses Ergebnis auch eintritt: im Zeitplan, im Budget, und mit zufriedenen Partnern.

Gleichzeitig hast du einen zweiten Auftrag, der genauso wichtig ist: Du führst so viele Projekte wie möglich über unsere Standardprozesse, damit Klub als Plattform skalierbar bleibt und nicht in Sonderlösungen erstickt. Diese Doppelrolle – nach außen verbindlich, nach innen konsequent – ist der Kern des Jobs.
Wir freuen uns auf Mitunternehmer*innen, um gemeinsam mit dem jungen Team und Geschäftsführer Sebastian die Geschicke von Klub44 zu leiten.
Projektsteuerung
Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung unserer laufenden Kooperationsprojekte – von Kick-off bis Abschluss.
Planung von Meilensteinen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Terminen; Nachhalten, wenn es hakt.
Frühzeitiges Erkennen von Risiken und aktives Gegensteuern, statt Überraschungen am Projektende.
Sicherstellen, dass zugesagte Ziele (z. B. teilnehmende Standorte, aktive Jugendliche, Angebots-Uploads) tatsächlich erreicht werden.
Account Management & Partnerbetreuung
Du bist die verlässliche Ansprechperson für unsere Projektpartner in Kommunen, Schulen und Stiftungen – die Stimme von Klub im Alltag.
Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen: Bestehende Kooperationen erfolgreich umsetzen, verlängern und ausbauen.
Erwartungsmanagement mit Verwaltungen, Schulleitungen und Förderpartnern: klar sagen, was geht, und was nicht.
Übersetzungsarbeit zwischen kommunaler Logik und Startup-Tempo – in beide Richtungen.
Skalierbarkeit & Standardprozesse
Onboarding von Kommunen, Schulen und Jugendeinrichtungen entlang unserer Standardprozesse – wiederholbar statt jedes Mal neu.
Weiterentwicklung dieser Prozesse: Playbooks, Templates, Checklisten, Automatisierungen.
Erkennen, wann eine Partneranfrage ein Sonderfall ist – und wann sie in ein neues Standardangebot gehört.
Bewusstes Nein zu Individuallösungen, die uns langfristig teuer werden.
Zahlen, Reporting & Wirkung
Nachhalten der Projekt-KPIs und transparentes internes Reporting zum Projektstatus.
Aufbereitung von Projektständen und Wirkungsdaten für Zuwendungsgeber und Stiftungen – die Verantwortung für Verwendungsnachweise und Reportings liegt bei der Geschäftsführung, du lieferst die Grundlage.
Ableiten konkreter Maßnahmen aus den Zahlen, nicht nur Dokumentation.
Zusammenarbeit im Team
Enge Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing & Community und Produktentwicklung.
Rückkopplung von Partner-Feedback ins Produkt: Was brauchen Kommunen und Standorte wirklich?
Steuerung externer Partner und Dienstleister im Projektkontext.
Qualifikation
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und bringst Projekte nachweislich zum Abschluss – idealerweise mit Partnern aus Verwaltung, Bildung, Stiftungen oder NGOs. Arbeitserfahrung in einem Startup ist ein guter Bonus.
Du bist stark in Kooperation und Kommunikation: Du gewinnst Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele und behältst dabei die Interessen von Klub im Blick.
Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, nicht in Einzelfällen – und hast Freude daran, Wiederholbares zu bauen.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und verbindlich: Zusagen, Fristen und Follow-ups sitzen bei dir.
Du bist "hands on" und sicher im Umgang mit agilen Methoden und Projektmanagement-Tools.
Du arbeitest datenbasiert und bist sicher im Nachhalten von Kennzahlen.
Dich motivieren unternehmerische Herausforderungen und du möchtest persönlich dazu beitragen, Jugendliche bei einer chancengerechten Entfaltung ihrer Potenziale zu fördern.
Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse.
Als junges, gemeinnütziges Startup sind wir noch limitiert, wollen aber mittelfristig marktgerecht zahlen. Bis wir das hinkriegen, können wir auch kreativ sein.

Global Trials Optimization Specialist
Sponsor Dedicated/ Remote - US only
Are you energized by using data, planning, and cross-functional collaboration to help clinical trials enroll successfully? We’re seeking a Global Trials Optimization Specialist to support program feasibility, recruitment and retention planning, and in-life trial optimization across global clinical studies.
In this role, you’ll help translate trial goals, country input, modeling data, and enrollment insights into practical strategies that support study execution. You’ll partner with clinical trial teams, vendors, legal, analytics, and other stakeholders to identify enrollment opportunities, address challenges, and support patient- and site-facing recruitment efforts.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining clinical trial operations, feasibility strategy, recruitment planning, stakeholder coordination, and performance analysis to help studies reach the right participants.

Program Feasibility and Trial Optimization
Gather data, benchmarks, and modeling inputs to support feasibility and trial optimization planning.
Support program review development, including content review and escalation of requirements as needed.
Plan timelines for validation, deliverable development, stakeholder alignment, presentation preparation, and country validation requests.
Support validation and Clinical Trials Allocation Committee activities, including scenario planning, risk table inputs, validation review, modeling updates, and final allocation requests.
Author the initial Global Trials Optimization Report and maintain subsequent report updates throughout the trial lifecycle.
Complete recruitment needs assessments and ensure trial-level GTO reports remain current and actionable.
Recruitment and Retention Planning
Lead early recruitment and retention planning during feasibility, including inputs for project cost estimates.
Develop initial recruitment needs assessments and, where applicable, program-level recruitment budget estimates.
Submit vendor requests and prepare recruitment and retention plans.
Partner with legal on concept reviews, vendor proposal reviews, scope of work finalization, and material or tactic reviews.
Ensure recruitment and retention plans, including enrollment support materials, are implemented effectively.
Oversee enrollment support material development and tactic execution.
Provide required materials to the Metrics, Analytics & Performance team to support accurate Study Optimizer plan entry.
Request and manage appropriate system updates as trial needs evolve.
In-Life Trial Management
Partner with study teams to identify enrollment challenges, assess risks, and recommend potential mitigations.
Manage routine enrollment support materials and vendor activities.
Monitor enrollment performance and prepare standard reporting.
Analyze performance trends and identify opportunities for enhanced support.
Coordinate enhanced enrollment support activities, which may include:
Rescue site and country activities
Internal recruitment and retention refresher meetings
External recruitment and retention booster meetings
Additional participant- or site-facing materials
Rescue vendor engagement
Advocacy engagement and community outreach

Experience supporting clinical trials, feasibility, recruitment planning, enrollment strategy, or trial optimization.
Strong ability to gather, interpret, and apply data to support planning and decision-making.
Experience coordinating timelines, deliverables, stakeholder reviews, and cross-functional inputs.
Ability to work with clinical trial teams, vendors, legal, analytics, and other business partners.
Strong written communication skills, including the ability to develop clear reports, plans, updates, and study-facing materials.
Detail-oriented approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced clinical research environment.

Oncology clinical trial experience, especially in lung or breast cancer studies .
Prior experience as an oncology site coordinator .
Experience with recruitment and retention vendors, enrollment support materials, or patient/site-facing recruitment tactics.
Familiarity with enrollment monitoring, performance analysis, country validation, risk tables, or trial allocation processes.
Why This Role Matters
Successful clinical trials depend on reaching the right participants, supporting sites effectively, and responding quickly when enrollment challenges arise. As a Global Trials Optimization Specialist, your work will directly support smarter planning, stronger recruitment strategies, and more effective trial execution.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence global study planning, collaborate with experienced clinical research partners, and help improve how trials connect with patients and sites.
Candidate Profile
We’re especially interested in candidates with oncology trial experience and a strong understanding of site operations, enrollment strategy, and recruitment/retention planning. Internal candidates will be prioritized initially; external candidates may be considered after the initial internal review period.
If you’re a clinical research professional who enjoys bringing structure, insight, and strategy to trial enrollment planning, we’d like to hear from you. Apply today to help support meaningful clinical trials through thoughtful feasibility, recruitment, and optimization work.

Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.
We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there.
For more information, visit .
Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia
At Arcadia , the Enterprise Implementation Manager (EIM) is the customer's primary point of accountability from contract signature through the life of the relationship.

The EIM manages a portfolio of enterprise accounts, leading each customer through onboarding and the technical work required to bring them live — including project managing new data connector builds — but the role exists to protect and grow the value the customer realizes from Arcadia 's platform.

EIMs proactively build the client relationship, drive adoption, resolve risk before it threatens retention, and act as the customer's trusted advisor long after go-live, ensuring customer value is clearly tracked & regularly reviewed.
The ideal candidate is a relationship-first operator: someone who can run a technical delivery workstream competently, but who is just as comfortable owning a client conversation, coaching a teammate, or spotting an account risk before it becomes a retention problem.
What Success Looks Like
In 3 months
Complete onboarding and current product and enablement certifications; build a working understanding of the platform, data model, and Arcadia 's customer success playbooks. The optional Arcadia Certified Professional program is available for continued growth. Shadow tactical client touchpoints and status conversations to learn how EIMs build trust and manage expectations across a client relationship
Take ownership of a defined workstream — for example, project managing a new data connector build — with support from your manager and technical partners
In 6 months
Independently manage cross-team workflows (data integration, configuration, connector builds) while keeping priorities visible and surfacing risk early
Lead tactical client conversations and standing touchpoints, delivering clear, timely updates that keep stakeholders aligned and confident
Proactively identify and escalate delivery or account risk, applying established playbooks to resolve issues efficiently and maintain momentum
Begin building trusted relationships with client stakeholders, understanding their unique technical and business priorities
Contribute to Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), or steering committees for your accounts, and become fluent in maintaining account health scores in Planhat
Build fluency with Arcadia 's customer feedback channels, including the Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT), as part of engaging your accounts
In 12 months
Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts as the primary point of contact — coordinating delivery, connector project management, and ongoing value acceleration & account health under one roof
Drive accountability for on-time, high-quality delivery of commitments, from new data connector implementations to platform adoption milestones
Independently lead recurring QBRs, EBRs, or steering committees, and own the Planhat health score and NPS trajectory for your portfolio, working toward a consistently green status
Partner effectively with the Customer Growth and Retention (CGR) team on renewal and expansion conversations, providing account context and continuity while CGR owns the commercial process
Identify and document process or value improvements, contributing refinements that strengthen delivery consistency and customer outcomes
Share lessons learned and best practices with peers, informally mentoring newer EIMs and Project Associates
What You'll Be Doing
Customer Relationship & Trust
Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts, serving as the customer's primary point of contact throughout the engagement.
Lead tactical status conversations and standing project meetings, delivering clear, timely updates on progress, risk, and next steps.
Facilitate regular touchpoints to align priorities, answer client questions, and maintain stakeholder trust.
Prepare accurate, client-ready documentation and materials that support transparent communication.
Account Health & Governance
Serve as the customer's primary point of accountability for delivery outcomes and overall account health across your portfolio.
Lead recurring QBRs, EBRs, or steering committees with client leadership, tying progress to shared goals, ROI, and next steps.
Maintain each account's health score in Planhat, incorporating usage, engagement, and other signals; own the goal of moving accounts toward a consistently green status. Contribute to your segment's (Core, Enterprise, or National) Net Promoter Score (NPS), which factors into incentive compensation at the segment level rather than by individual account.
Build fluency with Arcadia 's customer feedback channels — including CSAT — as part of the company's growing Voice-of-Customer program.
Partner with the CGR team on renewal and expansion conversations, providing account context, continuity, and delivery insight; CGR owns the commercial renewal and upsell process.
Proactively identify and escalate delivery and account risk; apply established playbooks to resolve issues efficiently.
Maintain project and account momentum through consistent follow-through and clear ownership of open items.
Drive accountability for commitments by managing dependencies and communicating progress across all workstreams.
Implementation & Data Connector Project Management
Project-manage new data connector builds and platform configuration workstreams from kickoff through validation and go-live.
Ensure smooth data orchestration through configuration validation, and maintain detailed documentation of process flows and integrations.
Partner cross-functionally with Data & Health Platform (DHP) teams and engineering to resolve data alignment issues and strengthen reporting reliability.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Manage workflows to maintain alignment and efficiency across internal teams, third parties, and the client.
Coordinate delivery activities and track interdependencies so priorities stay visible and risks surface early.
Ensure project team collaboration and escalate promptly if a workstream is tracking behind.
Value Realization & Continuous Improvement
Identify and document process or workflow enhancements that improve customer outcomes and internal efficiency.
Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing refinements and strengthening knowledge capture across projects.
Connect delivery and account activities to the customer's broader adoption and value-realization goals.
Coaching & Knowledge Sharing
Share lessons learned and best practices from client engagements with peers and newer team members.
Apply feedback to continuously refine your own skills and performance, modeling a growth mindset for the team.

The Educational Program Manager provides leadership and supervision to staff; develops professional development programs for educators; develops, manages and evaluates onsite, distance and online learning initiatives and student programming; and collaborates with internal and external partners to advance the CVC's educational mission.

Duties As an Educational Program Manager, you will: Provide administrative and technical supervision to subordinate staff, including assigning work, evaluating performance, establishing performance expectations, approving leave, providing coaching and training, and addressing employee performance and conduct matters.

Lead and motivate staff and multidisciplinary teams responsible for developing and delivering educational and public programming. Plan, develop, implement and evaluate professional development programs for educators, including teacher workshops, advisory groups and other educational initiatives.

Research and develop educational content, activities, primary source materials and resources that support program goals and applicable educational standards. Develop, manage and implement distance learning programs and digital educational resources for local and national audiences.

Research emerging practices and technologies related to virtual learning and educational programming and collaborate with information technology and audiovisual professionals to implement distance learning products.

Develop and manage onsite educational programs for students and other audiences, including establishing program goals, learning objectives, interpretive methods and quality-assurance standards.

Lead and participate in cross functional teams responsible for developing and improving student tours, educational programs and the overall school-group experience. Evaluate educational programs and recommend improvements based on program objectives, audience needs and recognized practices within informal learning environments.

Coordinate with staff, volunteers, educators, schools and other stakeholders to schedule and deliver educational and public programs. Collaborate with Communications and Marketing staff to promote educational programs and develop content for websites, handouts, brochures, signs and other educational and outreach materials.

Establish and maintain relationships with educators, schools, community organizations and other stakeholders to promote the Capitol Visitor Center as a resource for civic education.

* Act as a strategic advisor to the Senior Management Team (SMT) on people-related matters, organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, and talent management, and social dialogue including with union and staff representatives.

s.h: A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.
We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

The Operations Procesess Manager is responsible for driving global business performance through the standardization, optimization, and governance of planning processes across the value chain.

This role establishes an integrated, data-driven planning framework that aligns demand, supply, and financial objectives, enables cross-functional collaboration, improves operational efficiency, strengthens supply chain resilience, and ensures strategic alignment between business processes and supporting systems.
** **

* Define, standardize, harmonize, and deploy global planning process standards, ensuring consistent data definitions, effective operational handoffs, and seamless system integration across functions.

* Drive organizational transformation initiatives by enabling process adoption, capability development, and alignment with business objectives.
* Lead the redesign and enhancement of the Order Confirmation Engine in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations to ensure customer order commitments are based on validated material and capacity availability.
* Drive functional and system improvements that prevent unverified auto-commitments and support accurate first-time order confirmations.
* Design, implement, and continuously improve advanced Available-to-Promise (ATP) and Capable-to-Promise (CTP) capabilities within the planning ecosystem.
* Develop and deploy constrained planning models that incorporate material, bill of materials (BOM), production capacity, machine, and labor constraints before order confirmation.
* Serve as the primary liaison between Supply Chain and IT, translating planning requirements into system enhancements and overseeing solution design, testing, deployment, and global rollout activities.
* Ensure alignment and integration of business processes and IT systems through close collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
* Coordinate and facilitate stakeholder meetings to prioritize, plan, and monitor process and system enhancements in D365 and related applications.
* Approve solution designs and support governance processes for new system developments.
* Coordinate system releases, testing activities, defect resolution, and deployment readiness in partnership with business and IT teams.
* Govern the documentation and continuous improvement of the Target Operating Model (TOM), ensuring processes are translated into scalable standards, policies, and frameworks.
* Develop and maintain training materials and support organizational learning in collaboration with Process Owners, Process Stewards, and trainers.
* Define, implement, and monitor KPIs to measure process performance, compliance, adoption, and effectiveness.
* Establish and oversee reporting standards to ensure harmonized performance reporting across all locations.
* Conduct internal audits to verify compliance, identify improvement opportunities, and support process excellence.
* Lead continuous process improvement initiatives by identifying inefficiencies, implementing corrective actions, and monitoring business outcomes.
* Collaborate with process owners, managers, and functional leaders to ensure planning processes remain efficient, compliant, scalable, and aligned with business priorities.
** **

* Excellent English communication skills required; German language skills are advantageous.

* Deep knowledge of global ERP systems, particularly MRP functionality, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
* Experience leading business process standardization, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives in a global environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex cross-functional stakeholders and drive organizational change.
* Experience overseeing system enhancements, solution design reviews, testing activities, and release management processes.
* Strong capability to translate technical concepts and system requirements into clear business language.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making.

Project Manager, Client Onboarding
CrelioHealth Inc. · Remote (United States) · Full-time · Travel to client sites (~25–40%)
Compensation: $95,000 – $120,000 base, depending on experience + performance incentives (including incentives on expansion or referral opportunities you help close). Benefits include health coverage and PTO.
About CrelioHealth
CrelioHealth builds cloud-based laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS) that power diagnostic labs across the United States and 2,500+ labs worldwide. Our platform runs the full lab workflow — from order booking and specimen tracking through result reporting, patient engagement, billing, and inventory — for physician office labs, hospital labs, reference labs, and direct-to-consumer testing companies. We are HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and growing quickly in the US market.

When a lab signs with CrelioHealth , you are the person who turns that signature into a running lab. You will own client onboarding end to end: planning the implementation, configuring the rollout with our product and support teams, training lab staff, managing the go-live, and making sure the client is delighted enough to expand and refer. You are the face of CrelioHealth from kickoff to steady state.
This is not a sales role. You carry no quota and you will never cold-call. But onboarding is where trust is built, and trust is where growth comes from. We want someone who can confidently present the platform, handle a skeptical lab director, and spot the moment a client is ready for another module or another location — and who earns incentives when those opportunities convert.

Lead onboarding projects for new US clients — single-site labs through multi-location networks — from kickoff through go-live and handover to support.
Build and run the implementation plan: scope, milestones, data migration, instrument interfaces, integrations (EHR/EMR, billing, HL7/FHIR), user setup, and validation.
Coordinate internal teams (product, engineering, support) and client stakeholders (lab directors, pathologists, techs, front-desk, billing, IT) to keep every go-live on schedule.
Travel to client sites for kickoffs, go-lives, and training — roughly 25–40% of your time, varying with the project calendar.
Make clients successful
Train lab staff on real workflows — accessioning, worklists, QC, reporting, patient portal — and adapt the training to how each lab actually operates.
Anticipate and manage change resistance: a lab switching its LIS is changing how everyone works, and you will guide them through it.
Track onboarding health (time-to-go-live, adoption, early ticket volume) and report status honestly to clients and leadership.
Champion the platform
Present and demo CrelioHealth confidently — to the client team that signed, and to the wider staff who did not choose it but must love it.
Identify expansion opportunities during onboarding (additional modules, locations, or referrals) and hand them to the growth team — with incentives for you when they close.
Feed what you learn on the ground back into product and our onboarding playbook, which you will help write.

4–7 years of project management experience , with at least 2 years implementing or onboarding software for external clients.
Healthcare experience is required ; hands-on time in a clinical laboratory or laboratory environment is strongly preferred — as a lab tech, lab manager, LIS analyst, or implementer of lab systems (LIS/LIMS, EHR, RCM).
Fluency with lab operations concepts: specimen lifecycle, accessioning, QC/QA, instrument interfacing, CLIA/CAP context, HIPAA, and result reporting.
Excellent presenter and communicator — comfortable running a room of skeptical clinicians, and equally comfortable on a video call with a solo lab owner.
Structured and self-managing: you can run multiple concurrent onboardings remotely without anyone chasing you.
Willingness to travel to client sites across the US; valid driver’s license and authorization to work in the United States.
Nice-to-haves
Direct experience with an LIS/LIMS migration or go-live (any vendor).
Familiarity with HL7v2 / FHIR interfaces, lab billing/RCM basics, or instrument middleware.
Experience in customer success, solutions consulting, or pre-sales — anywhere you have had to win people over, not just manage tasks.
PMP, CAPM, or Lean Six Sigma is welcome but not required — we care more about go-lives you have shipped than certificates you hold.
Comfort using modern AI tools to work faster (drafting plans, summarizing calls, preparing training material) — with the judgment to know what still needs a human.
How We Hire
We know polished resumes and cover letters are easy to generate these days, so our process is built around watching you work rather than reading about it. After a screening call, you will do a live onboarding simulation based on a realistic lab scenario, and a short role-play where you present CrelioHealth to a (friendly but skeptical) “lab director.” No trick questions, no take-home busywork — just the actual job, compressed. We will respect your time and give you a decision quickly.
The Fine Print
CrelioHealth Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

At Zurich, our ambition is to put customers at the heart of everything we do and become the insurer of choice by building meaningful relationships that earn customer loyalty over time.
Over the past several years, we have made significant progress in building customer thinking into our strategy, products, services and ways of working. However, there is still more to do to ensure customer perspectives consistently shape decisions across the organisation and become embedded in our everyday mindset and culture. We believe better customer understanding leads to better business decisions.
The Group Customer Office plays a central role in this transformation, partnering with markets and functions around the world to ensure the voice of the customer is heard, understood and acted upon. Through customer, market and brand insights, we help the business better understand changing customer needs, identify opportunities for improvement and make decisions that strengthen customer loyalty, drive growth and create long-term value.
To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, curious and commercially minded insights professional to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in translating our data and research into actionable insights that influence business decisions and drive meaningful change.
Working closely with markets, regional stakeholders and senior leaders, you will help evolve and deliver our global brand and experience insights tracking tools to deliver value to the business, ensuring customer understanding influences business decisions and actions.
As we continue to embrace AI and new analytical capabilities, we are also transforming how insight is generated and activated, allowing us to spend less time producing reports and more time influencing decisions and delivering impact.
Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, this role will focus on understanding how our brand health created through our products, services and experiences shapes customer perceptions and behaviours, and ensuring those insights are translated into actions that improve customer outcomes and business performance.

s.h: As Senior Insight Manager you will
s.t:
* Champion the voice of the customer, helping embed customer thinking into decision-making across Zurich.
* Generate compelling customer and brand insights that influence to drive business impact
* Oversee Zurich's global retail Brand and Relationship NPS programmes and lead our Commercial Broker study, ensuring high-quality delivery, governance and business value.
* Evolve our insight programmes and measurement approaches to ensure they remain relevant to changing customer and business needs.
* Transform complex data into clear, actionable recommendations and executive-level narratives that drive action.
* Partner with the insights team, markets, agencies and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve business challenges and accelerate customer-centred change.
* Connect customer, brand and business data to strengthen understanding of performance drivers and commercial impact.
* Facilitate discussions and workshops that turn insight into tangible business outcomes.
* Work closely with the Tracking Insight Manager and TNPS Expert to maximise the impact, adoption and activation of insights across the organisation.
* Bring external best practice, innovation and emerging AI capabilities into Zurich's insight ecosystem to continuously enhance how we generate and apply insight.
Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

s.h: As Senior Insight Manager, you will bring
s.t:
* A passion for understanding customers and translating customer, market and brand data into meaningful business opportunities and actions.
* Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to distil complex information into clear, compelling narratives that influence decision-making.
* Proven experience activating insights within organisations, driving awareness, engagement and action across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Expertise in leading continuous and ad hoc qualitative and quantitative research programmes, either within an in-house insights function or consultancy environment.
* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect customer insights with business performance, growth and loyalty outcomes.
* Experience managing complex global programmes and building effective relationships across markets, functions and cultures.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders, facilitating discussions and workshops that drive alignment and action.
* Curiosity and practical experience applying AI and emerging technologies to enhance insight generation, synthesis and activation.
* Strong analytical skills with experience working with large datasets and statistical tools (e.g. Excel, SPSS), turning data into actionable recommendations.
* Experience bringing together multiple data sources to identify performance drivers and generate deeper business understanding.
* A degree (e.g. in business studies, marketing, research, psychology, behavioural science, customer or change management or a related field), alongside significant experience in customer, market or brand insights.
* Knowledge of the insurance sector is beneficial but not essential; curiosity, commercial thinking and a customer-first mindset are critical.
* Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
**You belong here. **
Imagine working in one of the world-s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus, you-ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You-ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance - offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to -create a brighter future together,- we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.
We look forward to receiving your online application today!

The best person for this role thinks like an owner of the account, not a coordinator of it.

Own delivery end to end: Run enterprise implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization, accountable for scope, timeline, budget, quality, and client satisfaction on every engagement you lead.
Build & manage the plan: Break down complex, ambiguous requirements into a clear project plan with phases, milestones, dependencies, and owners, keeping it current and making trade-offs visible when reality shifts.
Lead requirements gathering: Own the business requirement sessions end to end, facilitating discovery workshops that surface what the client actually needs, documenting requirements in a structured, unambiguous format, managing sign-off, and keeping them traceable through design, build, and testing.
Run the cross-functional team: Coordinate solution architects, engineers, QA, and client stakeholders toward a shared outcome, removing blockers, resolving conflicts, and making sure everyone knows what they own and by when.
Own the client relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact, leading status meetings, steering committee updates, and escalations, setting expectations early, and protecting the relationship even during hard conversations.
Manage scope, risk & change: Hold the line on scope creep, documenting and quantifying changes before work starts, and manage risks and issues proactively with a live view of mitigation plans and early escalation.
Stay technical, report & improve: Understand the architecture, integrations, and configuration decisions well enough to challenge estimates and speak credibly with engineers and technical buyers, produce honest, easy-to-read status reports and executive updates, and feed lessons learned back into delivery methodology.
What Success Looks Like
On-target delivery: Projects land on time, on budget, and within scope, with a clear plan stakeholders trust.
Trusted clients: Clients feel informed and in control throughout the engagement, and would take your call for the next one.
Managed risk: Risks surface early and get managed, so escalations are rare and never a surprise.
Aligned team & clean handoffs: The delivery team is aligned, unblocked, and clear on priorities, and handoffs to support and account teams are clean, with nothing left undocumented.
What You'll Need
Experience: 5+ years managing technical or software implementation projects, ideally in enterprise SaaS, professional services, or a client-facing delivery environment, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within budget as the primary delivery owner for enterprise clients.
Technical fluency: You can read a solution design, understand integrations and data flows, and hold your own in a technical discussion without being the engineer.
Requirements & delivery craft: Proven ability to run requirements and discovery sessions and translate them into clear, documented business requirements, plus solid command of project management fundamentals (planning, estimation, dependency management, risk and issue tracking, and change control).
Stakeholder management: Excellent communication, comfort presenting to senior and executive audiences, and the ability to manage scope, timelines, and difficult conversations without losing the relationship.
Ways of working: Organized and calm under pressure, you over-communicate rather than under-communicate, you're direct when a project needs a hard truth and diplomatic when a relationship needs care, and you own outcomes rather than pointing to a process.
Preferred: An earlier technical role (engineering, solution architecture, or implementation consulting); experience delivering configurable enterprise platforms or workflow/automation software; fluency in both agile and traditional delivery and the judgment to know when to use which; experience in a regulated or risk-sensitive domain; PMP, PRINCE2, PSM, or equivalent certification; and exposure to AI-assisted or modern delivery tooling.
